environment.description: Rails 7.1 application deployed on AWS ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB) with standard HTTPS listener on port 443. ALB forwards traffic to target group on port 3000. PostgreSQL 15 RDS instance in same VPC. API keys are distributed to internal services. No additional request filtering or WAF rules configured on the ALB. Security groups allow inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 on the ALB.

config.tls: ACM certificate, standard TLS 1.2+ termination at ALB
